title: Sign monomial expectation under independent sampling
statement: Let $n\geq 0$, let $\mu_i\in[-1,1]$ for each $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Choose independent signs $X_i\in\{-1,1\}$ with mean $\mu_i$. Then the expectation of the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ is $\prod_{i\in S}\mu_i$.
